player_prompt.intro:
U ntse u tseba Tower of Hanoi le {num_disks} disks.
U na le ho arola disks ho tsa tower A ho ya tower C.
Ho arola disk, ngola tower e halalelang e le tower e ngolang (e.g., '[A C]').
Tseba hore u ka arola disk e halalelang, mme disk e kgolokgolo ha e ke e tsamaywe ka disk e nyenyane.
Ka sethalo sa hao, u ngole e le move e le 'ngwe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O ka ile wa araba e halalelitsoe '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: U boletse hore mohloli o fosahetseng kapa tora eo u batlang ho e sebelisa ha ea nepahala.
invalid_move.empty_tower: U ile ua leka ho tlosa disk tora e se nang letho.
invalid_move.same_tower: U ile ua leka ho isa disk tora e tšoanang.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: U ile ua leka ho beha disk e khōlō holim'a disk e nyenyane.

game_action.moved: U ile ua tlosa disk {disk} ho tloha {source} ho ea {target}.

outcome.win: Kea le leboha, u rarolotse bothata ba Tora ea Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Moeli oa ho fetoha o fihlile. U behile ka nepo {pct}% ea li-disc Toreng C.
